name: spark
title: Spark
description: Chat with Claude on the Spark, and drive the persistent mosh → tmux session on the Spark from Raycast: jump to Claude, open its agents view, start sessions, switch panes and repos.
author: cartertiernan

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Chat with Claude
commands.description: Talk to Claude Code on the Spark from a popover: @ file completion, pasted screenshots, drafts that survive closing Raycast

commands.name: goto-claude
commands.title: Go to Claude
commands.description: Focus the Spark tab and make the Claude pane active

commands.name: agents-page
commands.title: Claude Agents Page
commands.description: Open Claude Code's agents view in the Claude pane

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Search Claude Agents
commands.description: Search the background agents on the Spark; open one in a new tmux window

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Search Claude Sessions
commands.description: Search past Claude sessions from the Mac and the Spark (atuin); open one in pane 1's agent view, or copy its resume command

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Claude Session
commands.description: Go to pane 1's agent view with an empty new-task prompt (type the task there, with @ completions)

commands.name: second-pane
commands.title: Go to Shell Pane
commands.description: Focus the Spark tab and make the shell pane (pane 2) active

commands.name: goto-repo
commands.title: Go to Repo
commands.description: cd the shell pane into a repo under ~/src on the Spark

preferences.name: sshHost
preferences.title: SSH host alias
preferences.description: Alias in ~/.ssh/config with ControlMaster (written by `spark raycast install`)

preferences.name: window
preferences.title: tmux window
preferences.description: Window holding the Claude pane (1) and the shell pane (2)

preferences.name: tabMatch
preferences.title: Ghostty tab match
preferences.description: Substring of the Ghostty tab title that holds the Spark session (the remote shell titles it [<hostname>] ...)

preferences.name: srcDir
preferences.title: Repos directory
preferences.description: Directory on the Spark whose children are offered as repos

preferences.name: agentsKey
preferences.title: Agents view key
preferences.description: tmux key name that opens Claude Code's agents view when the prompt is empty

preferences.name: atuinPath
preferences.title: atuin binary
preferences.description: Local atuin, used to search synced Claude sessions

preferences.name: chatPermissionMode
preferences.title: Chat permission mode
preferences.description: Claude's permission mode for chat turns. Nothing can answer a permission prompt from Raycast yet, so anything that would ask is denied and Claude says so

preferences.name: chatModel
preferences.title: Chat model
preferences.description: Model for chat turns (e.g. opus, sonnet). Empty uses the box's Claude Code default

preferences.name: chatDefaultDir
preferences.title: Chat directory
preferences.description: Where a new chat runs on the Spark until you pick a repo (⌘N)
